desc: Ongoing military conflict between Russia and Ukraine since Feb 2022; the largest European land war since WWII. Combat concentrated in Donbas in 2026, heavy drone and missile warfare.
desc_cn: 2022年2月起俄罗斯与乌克兰持续军事冲突，为二战后欧洲最大规模地面战争。2026年战事集中于顿巴斯地区，无人机与远程导弹作战突出。

desc: Military conflict between Israel and Hamas in Gaza since Oct 2023. A 2026 ceasefire reduced large-scale fighting, but Israeli control over most of northern Gaza remains in place.
desc_cn: 2023年10月起以色列与哈马斯在加沙地带交战，为巴以冲突的重大升级。2026年达成停火后大规模战斗减弱，但以军仍控制加沙北部大部。

desc: Armed conflict between Sudanese Armed Forces and Rapid Support Forces since April 2023. Entering fourth year, with fighting in Khartoum, Darfur and Kordofan driving a massive humanitarian crisis.
desc_cn: 2023年4月起苏丹武装部队与快速支援部队交战，为苏丹独立以来最严重的内部武装冲突。战事已进入第四年，人道主义灾难深重。

desc: Regional military confrontation between the US, Israel and Iran erupting Feb 2026. Major airstrikes on Iran followed by Iranian retaliation, including temporary closure of the Strait of Hormuz; ceasefire reached but unresolved tensions persist.
desc_cn: 2026年2月美以联合对伊朗发动大规模军事打击，伊朗反击并一度关闭霍尔木兹海峡。后虽达成停火协议，实质性冲突及紧张局势仍持续。

desc: Political and military crisis following the Feb 2021 Myanmar coup, escalating into a multi-front civil war. 2026 military-organized elections were widely rejected, intensifying nationwide violence.
desc_cn: 2021年2月缅甸军方政变后陷入全面政治与军事危机，演变为多阵线内战。2026年军政府举行的选举遭广泛抵制，全国暴力升级。

desc: Severe gang-dominated security and humanitarian crisis in Haiti. State authority effectively collapsed since 2024; chronic massacres, extreme food insecurity and mass displacement persist.
desc_cn: 海地国家权威崩溃背景下由武装帮派主导的严重安全与人道主义危机。大规模屠杀、极端粮食不安全和人口流离失所长期持续。

desc: Military exchanges between Israel and Hezbollah along the Israel-Lebanon border, a spillover escalation from the Gaza war. Airstrikes and rocket fire continued regularly through 2026.
desc_cn: 以色列与黎巴嫩真主党在黎以边境的军事冲突，由加沙战争外溢升级。双方空袭与火箭弹交火持续至2026年。

desc: The 2026 U.S. midterm elections scheduled for Nov 8, 2026 to elect all 435 House seats, 33 Senate seats and 36 state governorships. Key partisan battle for control of Congress.
desc_cn: 2026年11月8日举行的美国中期选举，改选全部众议员、三分之一参议员及36州州长，为民主党与共和党争夺国会控制权的关键选战。

desc: Double major earthquakes (M7.2 and M7.5) striking northern Venezuela on June 24, 2026. Caused thousands of fatalities and widespread destruction in Caracas and coastal regions.
desc_cn: 2026年6月24日委内瑞拉北部发生7.2级与7.5级双重强震，加拉加斯及沿海地区大面积损毁，造成数千人死亡。

desc: M7.1 earthquake striking Kumamoto Prefecture, Kyushu, Japan on July 28, 2026. Registered maximum seismic intensity 7 (shindo 7); hundreds of aftershocks followed.
desc_cn: 2026年7月28日日本九州熊本县发生7.1级地震，最大震度达7级，为2016年熊本地震后九州最严重的地震灾害，引发数百次余震。

desc: Catastrophic cross-border floods and landslides sweeping Nepal and China's Tibet Autonomous Region in late August 2026. Caused by glacial lake outburst coupled with extreme monsoon rainfall.
desc_cn: 2026年8月下旬冰川湖溃决叠加极端季风雨引发的尼泊尔与中国西藏跨境特大洪水与泥石流灾害，造成数千人死伤或失踪。

desc: Historic energy cooperation framework between the United States and Venezuela reached in late August 2026, covering expanded oil production investment and strategic petroleum reserve cooperation.
desc_cn: 2026年8月底美国与委内瑞拉达成的历史性能源合作框架协议，涵盖石油生产投资扩建与战略石油储备深化合作等领域。

desc: Large-scale street protests in India led by the Cockroach Party movement in mid-July 2026, centered in New Delhi and demanding sweeping education system reform.
desc_cn: 2026年7月中旬印度蟑螂党运动领导的大规模街头抗议行动，以新德里为中心，核心诉求为推动教育体系全面改革。

desc: Protracted armed conflict in Somalia among the federal government, African Union forces and the al-Shabaab insurgency. Active fighting and periodic large-scale displacements continued into 2026.
desc_cn: 索马里联邦政府、非盟部队与青年党叛乱武装之间的长期武装冲突。叛乱活动持续，周期性大规模人口流离失所延续至2026年。

desc: OpenAI's release of the GPT-5 series of large language models through 2026, culminating in the flagship GPT-5.6 Sol that set new coding and reasoning benchmarks; some advanced access restricted by the U.S. government.
desc_cn: OpenAI于2026年陆续发布的GPT-5系列大语言模型，旗舰版GPT-5.6 Sol在编程与推理方面刷新多项基准，部分高级能力受美国政府管控。

desc: OpenAI's custom AI inference chip codenamed 'Jalapeño', co-developed with Broadcom and unveiled in June 2026. Designed to roughly halve inference costs compared with mainstream GPUs.
desc_cn: OpenAI与博通合作开发的代号Jalapeño的自研AI推理芯片，于2026年6月发布。相比主流GPU可将推理成本降低约一半，挑战英伟达地位。

desc: Google's flagship multimodal large model Gemini Omni, announced at Google I/O 2026. Marked a major leap in video understanding, content generation and editing capabilities.
desc_cn: 谷歌在2026年I/O开发者大会发布的旗舰多模态大模型Gemini Omni，在视频理解、生成与编辑能力上实现显著跃升，为谷歌AI核心产品。

desc: Third-generation SpaceX Starship super heavy-lift launch vehicle debuting May 2026. Multiple successful test flights advancing toward operational orbital missions including Starlink V3 satellite deployment.
desc_cn: SpaceX第三代星舰超重型运载火箭，2026年5月首飞成功，随后完成多次试飞并推进至实用化轨道任务，承担星链V3卫星部署等使命。

desc: Unitree Robotics' initial public offering on the Shanghai STAR Market in August 2026, marking the first A-share listing of a company primarily focused on humanoid robots.
desc_cn: 2026年8月宇树科技在上海科创板首次公开发行上市，成为中国A股首家以人形机器人为主营业务的上市公司。

desc: The 2nd World Humanoid Robot Games held in Beijing in August 2026. Major international competition with 666 teams competing across locomotion, manipulation and integrated AI tasks.
desc_cn: 2026年8月在北京举办的第二届世界人形机器人大赛，为国际性人形机器人竞技盛会，666支队伍在移动、操作、人工智能等项目上角逐。

desc: NVIDIA's next-generation AI accelerator lineup built on the Blackwell GPU architecture, unveiled with a massive $1 trillion AI chip production roadmap in early 2026.
desc_cn: 英伟达基于Blackwell架构的新一代AI加速芯片家族及万亿美元级芯片产能管线，为全球AI训练与推理算力的核心供应。

desc: OpenAI's record-setting $122 billion fundraising round closed in 2026 — the largest capital raise ever for an AI company — earmarked for next-generation models and compute infrastructure.
desc_cn: 2026年OpenAI完成的1220亿美元巨额融资，为AI公司史上最大规模单笔融资，用于下一代通用人工智能模型与基础设施研发。

desc: A major global surge in ransomware attacks through 2025–2026, rising over 40% year-on-year. Critical infrastructure, enterprises and government agencies worldwide have been widely targeted.
desc_cn: 2025至2026年全球勒索软件攻击同比激增逾四成，关键基础设施、企业与政府机构广泛受袭，为最突出的网络安全威胁之一。

desc: 2026 global macroeconomic landscape defined by sticky inflation, elevated interest rates and heightened uncertainty. Key themes include Fed policy trajectory, recession risk and bond market volatility.
desc_cn: 2026年全球宏观经济以通胀黏性、利率高位和不确定性加剧为主要特征，焦点包括美联储政策路径、衰退风险及主要经济体债市波动。

desc: The XXV Olympic Winter Games, jointly hosted by Milan and Cortina d'Ampezzo, Italy, Feb 6–22, 2026. Eight sports and 116 events; first Italian Winter Olympics since 2006.
desc_cn: 第25届冬季奥林匹克运动会，2026年2月6–22日由意大利米兰与科尔蒂纳丹佩佐联合举办，设8大项116小项，为意大利2006年后再度举办冬奥。

desc: The 23rd FIFA World Cup, co-hosted by the United States, Mexico and Canada, June 11 – July 19, 2026. First 48-team format; matches played across 16 cities in three countries.
desc_cn: 第23届国际足联世界杯，2026年6月11日至7月19日由美、墨、加三国联合举办，首次扩军至48支球队，横跨三国16座主办城市。

desc: The 2026 tennis Grand Slam season (Australian Open, French Open, Wimbledon, US Open). Headlined by Alcaraz completing the career slam at the Australian Open and Sinner's first Wimbledon crown.
desc_cn: 2026赛季网球四大满贯赛事（澳网、法网、温网、美网），阿尔卡拉斯澳网夺冠实现职业生涯全满贯，辛纳首夺温网冠军。

desc: The 31st UN Climate Change Conference (COP31), held Nov 9–20, 2026 in Antalya, Turkiye. Key UNFCCC negotiating session with 12 thematic days advancing global climate action.
desc_cn: 第31届联合国气候变化大会（COP31），2026年11月9–20日于土耳其安塔利亚举行，设12个主题日推进全球气候行动谈判。

desc: Apple Inc.'s CEO succession in September 2026. John Ternus succeeded Tim Cook as chief executive; Cook became executive chairman after 15 years leading the company.
desc_cn: 2026年9月苹果公司最高管理层交接：约翰·特努斯接替蒂姆·库克出任CEO，库克在掌舵15年后转任执行董事长。

desc: Major Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo in 2026. One of the largest recorded Ebola epidemics, requiring large-scale international medical and humanitarian response.
desc_cn: 2026年刚果民主共和国暴发的大规模埃博拉病毒病疫情，为有记录以来最大规模埃博拉流行之一，需大规模国际医疗与人道主义响应。

desc: The 26th Shanghai Cooperation Organization Summit, held in Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan, September 1–2, 2026. Adopted the Bishkek Declaration and a multilateral nuclear safety partnership statement.
desc_cn: 2026年9月1–2日在吉尔吉斯斯坦比什凯克举行的第26届上海合作组织峰会，通过比什凯克宣言与多边核安全伙伴关系宣言等文件。

desc: The crossing of the $40 trillion mark by U.S. national debt in August 2026, a historic milestone. Debt-to-GDP ratio exceeded 123% with a $1.6 trillion annual deficit and over $1 trillion in yearly interest costs.
desc_cn: 2026年8月美国联邦国债总额突破40万亿美元大关，债务占GDP比重超123%，年度赤字1.6万亿美元，年利息支出逾1万亿美元。

desc: Escalating trade disputes between the European Union and China in 2026, centered on goods trade imbalances across multiple sectors including steel, electric vehicles and industrial manufactures.
desc_cn: 2026年欧盟与中国之间加剧的贸易争端，核心议题为货物贸易失衡，涉及钢铁、电动汽车及工业制成品出口等多个领域。

desc: A large-scale immigration enforcement operation by U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement across New York State in late summer 2026, one of the largest state-level immigration actions in recent years.
desc_cn: 2026年夏末美国移民和海关执法局在国土安全部主导下于纽约州开展的大规模移民执法行动，为近年最大规模的州级移民拘捕行动之一。
